commands.command:
install -d -m 0750 -o root -g apache /etc/pki/tls/node1
cat > /usr/local/sbin/renew-node1-cert <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
cert_dir=/etc/pki/tls/node1
cert="$cert_dir/cert.pem"
key="$cert_dir/key.pem"
renew_before_seconds=${RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS:-604800}
valid_days=${CERT_VALID_DAYS:-30}

if [ "${FORCE_RENEW:-0}" != 1 ] && [ -s "$cert" ] && [ -s "$key" ] && openssl x509 -checkend "$renew_before_seconds" -noout -in "$cert"; then
    echo "certificate remains valid beyond renewal window"
    exit 0
fi

umask 077
tmp_dir=$(mktemp -d "$cert_dir/.renew.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
node_host=$(hostname -s)
node_ip=$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -sha256 -days "$valid_days" \
    -subj "/CN=$node_host" \
    -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:$node_host,IP:$node_ip" \
    -keyout "$tmp_dir/key.pem" -out "$tmp_dir/cert.pem"
chmod 0640 "$tmp_dir/key.pem"
chown root:apache "$tmp_dir/key.pem"
chmod 0644 "$tmp_dir/cert.pem"
chown root:root "$tmp_dir/cert.pem"
mv -f "$tmp_dir/key.pem" "$key"
mv -f "$tmp_dir/cert.pem" "$cert"
restorecon -F "$key" "$cert" 2>/dev/null || true
openssl x509 -noout -serial -dates -subject -ext subjectAltName -in "$cert"
if systemctl is-active --quiet httpd; then
    /usr/sbin/httpd -t
    systemctl reload httpd
    echo "httpd gracefully reloaded"
fi
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/renew-node1-cert
/usr/local/sbin/renew-node1-cert

sed -i 's/^[[:space:]]*Listen[[:space:]]\+80[[:space:]]*$/# Disabled: HTTPS-only service uses 8443/' /etc/httpd/conf/httpd.conf
mv /etc/httpd/conf.d/ssl.conf /etc/httpd/conf.d/ssl.conf.disabled
cat > /etc/httpd/conf.d/node1-8443.conf <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
Listen 8443 https

<VirtualHost *:8443>
    ServerName node1
    DocumentRoot /var/www/html

    SSLEngine on
    SSLProtocol -all +TLSv1.2 +TLSv1.3
    SSLCertificateFile /etc/pki/tls/node1/cert.pem
    SSLCertificateKeyFile /etc/pki/tls/node1/key.pem

    <Directory /var/www/html>
        Require all granted
    </Directory>

    ErrorLog logs/node1-8443-error.log
    CustomLog logs/node1-8443-access.log combined
</VirtualHost>
ANTRIEB_EOF
cat > /var/www/html/index.html <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
node1 HTTPS service is healthy
ANTRIEB_EOF
restorecon -RF /etc/httpd/conf.d /var/www/html /etc/pki/tls/node1
